messages.author: 74a522eefdfed5da
messages.subject: Invalidate every x seconds
parts:
Is it possible to set a reactive function to invalidate every x seconds?

Say we wanted to have a stock ticker app, you select your stock and there's a reactive, timed function in the background that pulls down the prices every 5 minutes.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Invalidate every x seconds
parts: Yes. Now that you say that I can see why you read it that way. invalidateLater causes an invalidation to happen after the specified delay. If an invalidation happens sooner than that on the current reactive for any other reason, invalidateLater does nothing to prevent it.
On Sun, May 19, 2013 at 3:44 PM, Adam Edgley <adam....@gmail.com> wrote:
